summary: Round two does not meet the ship bar. Only one of 11 round-one items moved: the slide-6 collision is gone, so L1 passes with ≈54 pt clearance, but the stack was never rebuilt and still sits off the Dec column. Fixed requirement C1 fails: slide 3's source reads 'v2', not 'v1'. B1 passes. Every other round-one major and polish item is open: duplicate uptime claims, the half-empty slides 3 and 5, no amber highlight, and four runt headlines. Round one's 'delete slide 2' fix is withdrawn because it breaks the six-slide brief. This was the second and final review round. At minimum, fix the C1 string before delivery, and tell the user about the remaining majors.
